votes.motion: Approve the work session minutes of December 5, 2023 and December 12, 2023 as well as the formal meeting minutes of January 9, 2024, January 16, 2024 and the Oath of Office Minutes from January 2, 2024
votes.description: The Council approved multiple sets of prior meeting minutes, including work session and formal meeting minutes from December 2023 and January 2024, as well as the January 2, 2024 Oath of Office minutes.
The Council adopted a ceremonial resolution regarding peace, with each Council Member reading a section of the Resolution for Peace.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (University of Utah Baseball Stadium Public Benefits Analysis)
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the proposed 99-year below-market ground lease to the University of Utah for approximately 1.175 acres at Sunnyside Park and deferred a final decision to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 06 of 2024 (Avenues Restrictive Covenant)
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and adopted an ordinance relinquishing Salt Lake City's interests in restrictive covenants on 18 single-family properties in the Avenues neighborhood near LDS Hospital without changing their zoning.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing to a future Council meeting (Rezone at 2260, 2270, and 2290 East 1300 South)
votes.description: The Council continued the public hearing on a proposed rezone from R-1/7,000 to CB (Community Business District) for properties at 2260, 2270, and 2290 East 1300 South to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Community Benefit and Tenant Displacement Amendments)
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on proposed ordinance amendments to prevent loss of affordable housing and counteract tenant displacement under the Thriving in Place anti-displacement plan, deferring final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 07 of 2024 amending Fiscal Year 2024 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document for items A-1, A-7, A-9, and A-10, and authorize release of the condition regarding the air quality incentives program expansion
votes.description: The Council adopted Budget Amendment No. 4 for FY2023-24, approving specific items including an air quality incentives program expansion, increased fleet maintenance capacity, mobile phone data extraction software, and a case service software upgrade.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 04 of 2024, extending the time period for satisfying the conditions set forth in Ordinance No. 06 of 2023 by one year (Zoning Map Amendment at approximately 704 East 900 South)
votes.description: The Council adopted a resolution granting the property owner at approximately 704 East 900 South an additional one-year deadline to satisfy the conditions of the prior rezoning ordinance from R-2 to SNB.

The Council approved the consent agenda, which included setting public hearing dates for several ordinances and resolutions and approving seven board appointments to the Racial Equity in Policing Commission.
